measurement: cupyx.profiler.benchmark CPU host latency and CUDA-event stream elapsed time; output disposal timed. GPU intervals include host submission gaps, not isolated kernel time.
preparation_measurement: Single first-miss host intervals for construction, epilog preparation and plan; execution excluded. Wrappers removed before warm timing. Compiler first use and driver caches affect these observations.
limitations: Curated cases have no production frequency weights. Only marked C2C default-forward cases use minimal and stateful. Native contrasts include backend plan, copy, scaling and output-layout differences; release_workspace applies only to the nvmath rows.

validation.row_agreement: Shared unscaled nvmath rows agree bitwise; fused Ajay and native checked independently against reference
validation.reference: NumPy FFT of the same input promoted to double
validation.accuracy: per-batch relative L2 <= 100 * input dtype epsilon; absolute L2 for zero references

artifact_format: Case summaries, validation and provenance. Per-call samples and block records remain in the raw result directory.
